name: Cindy Holscher
summary: Cynthia L. Holscher (née Blumhorst, born April 26, 1969) is an American politician who is the governor-elect of Kansas.  She represented the 16th district in the Kansas House of Representatives from 2017 to 2020 and has represented the 8th district in the Kansas Senate since 2021. She is a member of the Democratic Party and was its nominee in the 2026 Kansas gubernatorial election.
